title: Leave of Absence Figures for Assisted Living Residents
content:
The Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement relieves part of the care fee during a long temporary absence, never the rent. The figures are the same at every care level.

| Figure | Level 1 | Level 2 | Level 3 | Level 4 | Level 5 | Level 6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Midnights of a continuous absence not credited before the care fee credit begins (absence credit waiting period) | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 |
| Maximum days credited for one continuous absence | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Percentage of the daily care level fee credited for each credited day (absence credit percentage) | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Apartment rent credited during an absence | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Midnights of a continuous absence at which the executive director reviews whether the apartment continues to be held | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |

### Basis Q&A

**Is rent reduced while a resident is away?** No. Rent is not credited during an absence at any care level.

**At what point does the apartment-hold review arise?** When a continuous absence reaches 60 midnights; the decision belongs to the executive director.
